source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eight Heywood Docks rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: The Cylinders
entities.source_summary: Former tanker trucks converted into crude residential units for much of the permanent Docks population; no public rental business is established.

entities.name: Decker, Tanaka & Rogers
entities.source_summary: Corporate cargo-hauling office that coordinates ship and truck logistics, handles manifests and negotiates freight contracts with local businesses.

entities.name: Dockside Billhooks Track
entities.source_summary: Home track for the Dockside Billhooks roller-derby squad, used for training and hosted bouts with spectator seating.

entities.name: Greenbox Storage Units
entities.source_summary: Secure climate-controlled storage facility renting armored units; some customers live in units despite the site not being a hotel. A guard station includes ordinary vendits without source-defined merchandise.

entities.name: HF&S Construction
entities.source_summary: Construction company and rebuilding contractor headquartered at a site containing offices, a yard and warehouses.

entities.name: LoadStar Continental Shipping
entities.source_summary: Continental Brands freight company offering commercial shipping while its Docks office coordinates cargo handling and maintains company ships and trucks.

entities.name: Rail Yard
entities.source_summary: Cargo-transfer rail infrastructure used to move freight from ships onto trains; no public customer-facing operation is established.

entities.name: Shipping Yard
entities.source_summary: Guarded lots and warehouses used to hold cargo temporarily before onward transport; no distinct public storage-rental business is stated.
